notes.title: New Game: Thot On Trial
notes.notes: [h2]Our new game [b]Thot On Trial[/b] is now available for                                      [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320410/Thot_on_Trial" style="button"]WISHLIST[/url]                   [/h2][h2]We hope you will check it out :) [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/eac971836a9251496edf9b3731246209b1911887.png"][/img][/h2][p]Thot on Trial is an adult visual novel that explores temptation, betrayal, and the slow unraveling of a marriage under pressure. With themes of NTR, power play, and moral corruption, this story invites you into a world where lust and ambition often collide, and consequences are inevitable. In this thrilling and steamy story, you get to control both the Female and Male character.[/p][p]The story begins with a young couple moving from Chicago to Los Angeles. [i]The husband[/i] is chasing his dream, starting a new job as an environmental lawyer. Idealistic and full of conviction, he's determined to take down a powerful corporation polluting the planet. The case is solid, but he's in over his head, and his lack of experience is starting to show.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/4f8e48091534eb4cc7199b36bc97998d67adda6e.png"][/img][/p][p][i]The wife[/i], stunning and full of charm, dreams of a quiet life with her husband's full attention. But the reality is far from perfect. As he spends longer hours at the office, buried in court filings and legal briefs, she's left alone, and bored. In today's economy, even dreams have a price, and she'll soon be searching for work of her own.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/2c052e61728d2953969628bdfe029f4e8e8aad0c.png"][/img][/p][p]And then, there's [i]Alexander[/i]. Smooth, powerful, and ruthless, he runs the very corporation the husband is trying to bring down. Alexander doesn't take defeat lightly. He wants to win. He wants control. And more than anything… he wants her.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/75d253806d293548464a06eca3a0ce3fd6f079c4.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Anna[/i], Alexander's top lawyer, is brilliant, ruthless, and dangerously seductive. Assigned to crush the case, she also sets her sights on the man fighting it. She'll make his life a legal nightmare, and something far more complicated.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/f28eb6b95ec0cc693fdab988bd49b270f0303e21.png"][/img][/p][p]Along the way, you'll meet [i]Jay[/i], the charming next-door neighbor with impeccable timing. Trevor, the ex-boyfriend who never really let go. Charles, the mysterious boat captain with secrets of his own. And many others who will test loyalty, blur boundaries, and reshape what each character thought they knew about love, trust, and power.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919821/9733671d6f6e44210d3b83790fdd7e47c17dadf9.png"][/img][/p][p]Thot on Trial offers branching paths, layered relationships, and a slow descent into choices that can't be taken back. Will the husband stay true to his mission, or lose everything chasing a world that never loved him back?[/p][p]These are just some of the characters. Play along and meet all kinds of people who might make the story even more complicated... or interesting?[/p][p][b]Every decision matters. Every glance means more than it seems. And in the end, you decide how far the corruption goes.  [/b][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3320410/Thot_on_Trial" style="button"]WISHLIST[/url][/p]
